Chipping, cracks, worn edges or tooth mobility can sometimes be linked to an unbalanced bite. Bite evaluation helps identify excess pressure on teeth and supports planning for protection, restoration or correction when needed.

Use the Book button to schedule a bite assessment at Royal Dental Clinics.

Implant treatment should begin with planning, not guesswork. 3D imaging helps assess bone, sinus position, hidden infection and nearby teeth before surgery. In complex upper-jaw bone-loss cases, options such as zygomatic implants may be discussed after evaluation.

Use the Book button to plan your implant consultation.

Same-day fixed teeth may be possible in selected implant cases when bone quality, implant stability and bite conditions are suitable. Our team uses diagnostics and treatment planning to decide what is safe for your case.

Use the Book button to schedule an implant evaluation at Royal Dental Clinics, Kandivali.

Before designing a smile, we look at more than teeth. Smile analysis studies tooth display, gum visibility, lip movement, facial symmetry and bite. This helps plan treatment that looks natural and functions comfortably.

Use the Book button to schedule a smile analysis at Royal Dental Clinics.

If your smile shows more gum than you prefer, the reason may be tooth position, gum levels, lip movement or jaw relationship. Treatment may range from gum contouring to orthodontic or jaw-related planning in selected cases.

A proper diagnosis helps choose a safe, natural-looking option. Use the Book button to schedule an evaluation.

Veneers and crowns solve different problems. Veneers are usually considered for selected cosmetic changes on the front surface of a tooth. Crowns cover the tooth and are generally considered when more support or protection is needed.

The right choice should be decided after examination, imaging and bite assessment. Use the Book button to consult our team.

Thinking about a smile makeover? A natural-looking result starts with smile analysis — tooth shape, shade, gum line, facial balance and bite. Our cosmetic dentistry team discusses options such as whitening, bonding, veneers, aligners or crowns depending on your dental condition.

Use the Book button to schedule a smile analysis at Royal Dental Clinics.
